name: fairplay
description: FairPlay — provably-fair multi-game platform (Financial Core + Game Server)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix financial-core install && npm --prefix game-server install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.test: npm run test:fc && npm run test:gs
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix financial-core run typecheck && npm --prefix game-server run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --prefix financial-core run lint && npm --prefix game-server run lint
